# TU Delft OpenCourseWare

> Free, university-level open education platform offering engineering and STEM courses across multiple disciplines and degree levels.

TU Delft OpenCourseWare (OCW) provides free access to high-quality course materials from Delft University of Technology, ranging from high school STEM to advanced master's programs. The platform organizes content by thematic areas (energy, sustainability, water, health, infrastructure) and academic level, making world-class engineering education openly accessible globally.

## Getting Started

- [TU Delft OpenCourseWare](https://ocw.tudelft.nl): TU Delft OpenCourseWare homepage with free university-level courses
- [About OpenCourseWare - TU Delft OCW](https://ocw.tudelft.nl/about-ocw): TU Delft OpenCourseWare mission and overview of open education initiative
- [Faq - TU Delft OCW](https://ocw.tudelft.nl/about-ocw/faq): Frequently asked questions about OpenCourseWare and free course access

## Browse by Theme

- [Themes Archive - TU Delft OCW](https://ocw.tudelft.nl/themes): Course themes archive covering energy, environment, health, water, sustainability
- [Energy - TU Delft OCW](https://ocw.tudelft.nl/themes/energy): Energy courses including smart grids, renewable energy, and sustainable systems
- [Environment - TU Delft OCW](https://ocw.tudelft.nl/themes/environment): Environment courses on sustainability, climate change, and green infrastructure
- [Health - TU Delft OCW](https://ocw.tudelft.nl/themes/health): Health and biomedical engineering courses including robotic exoskeletons
- [Infrastructures and Mobility - TU Delft OCW](https://ocw.tudelft.nl/themes/infrastructures-and-mobility): Infrastructure and mobility courses on aerospace, water safety, engineering
- [Sustainability - TU Delft OCW](https://ocw.tudelft.nl/themes/sustainability-2): Sustainability theme courses on climate-neutral technology and urban development
- [Water - TU Delft OCW](https://ocw.tudelft.nl/themes/water): Water management and hydraulic engineering courses for civil engineering

## Browse by Academic Level

- [Programs Archive - TU Delft OCW](https://ocw.tudelft.nl/programs): Course programs archive by degree level and engineering discipline
- [Master - TU Delft OCW](https://ocw.tudelft.nl/programs/master): Master's level courses in aerospace engineering and advanced topics
- [Bachelor - TU Delft OCW](https://ocw.tudelft.nl/programs/bachelor): Bachelor's level courses in aerospace, earth sciences, and engineering
- [High School - TU Delft OCW](https://ocw.tudelft.nl/programs/high-school): High school STEM courses including math, programming, and pre-university calculus

## Specialized Topics

- [Transversal skills - TU Delft OCW](https://ocw.tudelft.nl/transversal-skills): Curriculum development and teaching methods for transversal skills education
- [Architecture Software - TU Delft OCW](https://ocw.tudelft.nl/more/architecture-software): Architecture design software tutorials including Grasshopper and Revit BIM

## Support & Feedback

- [Contact - TU Delft OCW](https://ocw.tudelft.nl/contact): Contact form and feedback channels for TU Delft OpenCourseWare users

- [Best Teachers - TU Delft OCW](https://ocw.tudelft.nl/more/best-teachers): Recognition of award-winning faculty and teaching excellence at TU Delft
- [Hall of Fame - TU Delft OCW](https://ocw.tudelft.nl/more/hall-of-fame): Awards and recognition for outstanding open education courses and MOOCs
